faqs.a: A favicon is the small icon browsers show in tabs, bookmarks, and history. PNG favicons work in modern browsers; the .ico format is still needed for older browsers and Windows shortcuts. This tool generates both.
faqs.q: What is a favicon and why do I need one?

faqs.a: Browsers pick the closest size: 16 and 32 px for tabs, 180 px for Apple touch icons, 192 and 512 px for Android/Chrome install prompts. The generated .ico bundles 16, 32, and 48 px in one file.
faqs.q: Which sizes do I actually need?

faqs.a: In Image mode, your picture is cover-fit: it is scaled so the smaller side fills the square and the excess is cropped, centered. Nothing is stretched or squashed.
Press Download .ico to get favicon.ico (16/32/48 px PNGs inside), then add the copied snippet to your site's <head>. Upload the files to your site root so the paths in the snippet match.
faqs.q: How do I install the favicon on my website?

faqs.q: Can I make a letter-based favicon?

faqs.a: The letter field accepts up to 2 characters. Single letters render largest and read best at 16 px; two letters work for brand initials like 'JT'.

favicon-generator.formula:
scale = max(target / width, target / height)
drawnW = width x scale, drawnH = height x scale
offsetX = (target - drawnW) / 2, offsetY = (target - drawnH) / 2
ICO file = 6-byte header + 16 bytes per entry + PNG data
Example: 3 entries (16/32/48) -> header bytes 0-5, entries bytes 6-53, PNG data from byte 54.

favicon-generator.workedExample:
You upload a 1000 x 600 px logo and press Generate.
For the 32 px icon: scale = max(32/1000, 32/600) = 0.0533, drawn as 53.3 x 32 px, cropped to a centered 32 x 32 square.
The .ico packs the 16, 32, and 48 px PNGs: header bytes 0–5, three 16-byte entries at bytes 6–53, then the PNG data.
